product_family: Google Workspace for Education: a suite of cloud-based learning management and productivity tools for K-12 and higher education, including Google Classroom (LMS), Gemini in Classroom (generative AI assistant), NotebookLM (AI-powered research notebook), Google Meet, and Read Along in Classroom

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type II
certifications.proof_quote: An independent third-party auditor has verified that Google's practices and contractual commitments for Google Workspace for Education are audited against SSAE 18 / ISAE 3402 Type II. SOC 2 Type II reports are issued quarterly and available via the Compliance Reports Manager.

certifications.name: SOC 1 Type II
certifications.proof_quote: Google Cloud and Google Workspace SOC 1 Type II reports are issued quarterly and downloadable via Compliance Reports Manager.

certifications.name: SOC 3
certifications.proof_quote: Gemini for Google Workspace is now SOC 1, SOC 2, and SOC 3 compliant. SOC 3 reports are publicly available.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 27001
certifications.proof_quote: ISO/IEC 27001 (Security) — listed directly on the Google for Education Privacy and Security page as a standard met by Google Workspace for Education via third-party audits.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 27017
certifications.proof_quote: Google ensures that Google Workspace products covered under the BAA align with ISO/IEC 27017 certifications and SOC 2 report. Google Workspace holds ISO/IEC 27017 (Cloud Security) certification.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 27018
certifications.proof_quote: Google ensures that Google Workspace products covered under the BAA align with ISO/IEC 27018 certifications. Google Workspace holds ISO/IEC 27018 (Cloud Privacy) certification.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 27701
certifications.proof_quote: ISO/IEC 27701 (Privacy) — listed directly on the Google for Education Privacy and Security page as a standard met by Google Workspace for Education via third-party audits.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 42001 (AI Management System)
certifications.proof_quote: ISO/IEC 42001 (AI) — listed directly on the Google for Education Privacy and Security page. Google achieved ISO 42001 certification for the Gemini app on web and mobile in December 2024; Google Cloud Platform and Google Workspace are certified as ISO/IEC 42001:2023 compliant.

certifications.name: GDPR
certifications.proof_quote: EU/EEA: GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation) — listed as a compliance standard on the Google for Education Privacy and Security page. A Cloud Data Processing Addendum (DPA) is available.

certifications.name: FERPA
certifications.proof_quote: US: FERPA (Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act) — explicitly listed on the Google for Education Privacy and Security page as a US compliance standard met by Google Workspace for Education.

certifications.name: COPPA
certifications.proof_quote: US: COPPA (Children's Online Privacy Protection Act of 1998) — explicitly listed on the Google for Education Privacy and Security page as a US compliance standard met by Google Workspace for Education.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: Customers subject to HIPAA may enter a Business Associate Amendment (BAA) with Google. The Gemini app on web and mobile achieved HIPAA certification in December 2024. Google ensures Google Workspace products covered under the BAA meet HIPAA requirements.

certifications.name: FedRAMP High
certifications.proof_quote: Gemini for Workspace achieved FedRAMP High authorization as announced in October 2024. The entire authorized Google Workspace security boundary is documented, assessed, and managed against the FedRAMP High baseline.

certifications.name: CSA STAR Level 2 (Attestation)
certifications.proof_quote: Google Cloud has achieved third-party assessment-based certification (CSA STAR Level 2: Attestation) for Google Cloud and Google Workspace, resulting in a CSA STAR SOC2+ report.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: Google Workspace compliance certifications include PCI DSS. Google Cloud undergoes at least an annual third-party audit to certify individual products against PCI DSS 4.0.1.

certifications.name: SIIA (Software and Information Industry Association) CODiE
certifications.proof_quote: US: Software and Information Industry Association — listed on the Google for Education Privacy and Security page as a US compliance standard met by Google Workspace for Education.

privacy.ai_training_note: Google explicitly states: 'no Google Workspace for Education data is used to improve or train AI models' and 'Chats with Gemini are not human reviewed or otherwise used to improve AI models.' This applies to all editions (Fundamentals and Plus). Admin-controlled access governs generative AI features.
privacy.data_region: Data region control available for Education Plus and Education Standard editions. Admins can set data regions per organizational unit or configuration group. Global by default on Fundamentals.

security.name: Encryption in transit
security.value: TLS enforced for all data in transit across Google Workspace services including Classroom

security.name: Encryption at rest
security.value: AES-256 encryption at rest; hardware security modules protect encryption keys

security.name: Uptime SLA
security.value: 99.9% guaranteed uptime (99% stated on edu.google.com); global full-stack network

security.name: Identity and access management
security.value: 2-factor authentication, Single Sign-On (SSO), and password management supported. Centralized Admin Console for domain-wide security settings

security.name: Threat detection
security.value: AI-powered proactive monitoring 24/7; automatic blocking of 99.9%+ of spam, phishing, and malware in Gmail; Security Center with real-time alerts

security.name: Audit logging
security.value: User activity log events available for detecting unsafe operations; Classroom logs exportable to BigQuery for adoption and engagement analysis

security.name: Admin console
security.value: Centralized Admin Console with controlled entry, domain-wide security settings, DLP rules, and data region policies

security.name: Third-party audits
security.value: Regular independent third-party audits verifying security, privacy, and compliance controls; reports available via Compliance Reports Manager at no additional cost

products.name: Google Classroom (Education Fundamentals)
products.data_scope: Student and educator data, assignments, grades, class materials, originality reports. No ads. No use of data for AI model training.
products.notes: Free tier for schools. Includes Gemini AI tools at no cost as of 2024. FERPA and COPPA compliant. Data owned by the institution.

products.name: Google Classroom (Education Plus)
products.data_scope: All Fundamentals scope plus analytics data, SIS integration data, BigQuery export. Data region control available.
products.notes: Paid tier. Adds Classroom analytics for leaders, data region selection, advanced security controls.

products.name: Gemini in Classroom
products.category: Generative AI / AI Assistant for Education
products.data_scope: Conversation content from educator/student AI interactions; not used to train AI models; Gemini chats not human-reviewed
products.notes: SOC 1/2/3, ISO 42001, HIPAA (Dec 2024), FedRAMP High (Oct 2024). Admin-controlled feature rollout.

products.name: NotebookLM
products.data_scope: Documents and materials uploaded by users; processed to generate summaries, Q&A, audio overviews
products.notes: Available as part of Workspace for Education through Gemini in Classroom teacher-led experiences.

products.name: Read Along in Classroom
products.data_scope: Student reading sessions, accuracy and speed data, comprehension metrics; educator analytics
products.notes: Available globally for K-12 students; real-time AI feedback on reading aloud. Part of Google Workspace for Education services.

products.name: Google AI Pro for Education
products.data_scope: Same as Gemini in Classroom scope; enterprise-grade data protection in Gemini applies
products.notes: Paid add-on with advanced Gemini capabilities for education customers. Available since 2025.

compare.pricing_model: Freemium: Education Fundamentals is free; Education Standard and Education Plus are paid; add-ons (Google AI Pro for Education, Teaching and Learning upgrade) available separately
compare.data_residency: Available in Education Standard and Education Plus via data region controls. Not available in free Fundamentals tier.

flags: HIPAA note: HIPAA compliance requires institutions to accept a Business Associate Amendment (BAA) with Google before using PHI. Not automatic. Education-tier HIPAA coverage was explicitly confirmed for the Gemini app in December 2024.

FedRAMP scope: FedRAMP High authorization announced October 2024 for Gemini for Workspace. The full Google Workspace boundary is managed against FedRAMP High, but education institutions must verify their specific configuration and edition qualify.

ISO 42001 was obtained specifically for the Gemini app on web and mobile in December 2024. While Google Workspace and Google Cloud Platform are listed as ISO 42001:2023 certified, Classroom-specific scope should be confirmed for formal procurement.

PCI DSS and CSA STAR certificates are at the Google Cloud and Google Workspace platform level; they cover the underlying infrastructure Google Classroom runs on, not Classroom as a standalone certified product.

Data region control is edition-gated: only available on Education Standard and Education Plus, not on the free Education Fundamentals tier. Institutions requiring data residency guarantees must use a paid edition.
The slug 'google-classroom-ai' is a catalog artifact; the official product name is Google Classroom, part of Google Workspace for Education, made by Google LLC.
